breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the product of inertia even though the setup explicitly gives a nonzero I_yz and the unsymmetric bending formula depends on it.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the full unsymmetric bending formula with Iyz included throughout all calculations. It explicitly instructs to substitute Iyz = 800000 mm^4 into the formula and compute the denominator as Iy·Iz − Iyz^2, matching the ground truth. The incorrect instruction to 'superpose My·z/Iy and Mz·y/Iz as though the product of inertia were zero' from the incomplete prompt is completely absent from the generated specification.
